# [CS050] Query Rows Not Closed (sql-rows-unclosed)

Rows from Query are never closed.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | HIGH |
| **Category** | Reliability & Concurrency |
| **CWE** | [CWE-404](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/404.html) |
| **OWASP** | A06:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

Rows hold a connection until they are closed or fully iterated. An early return or a panic inside the loop leaks the connection; defer rows.Close() covers both.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
rows, err := db.QueryContext(ctx, "SELECT name FROM users")
if err != nil {
	return nil, err
}
for rows.Next() {
	if err := rows.Scan(&name); err != nil {
		return nil, err // connection leaked
	}
}
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
rows, err := db.QueryContext(ctx, "SELECT name FROM users")
if err != nil {
	return nil, err
}
defer rows.Close()
for rows.Next() {
	if err := rows.Scan(&name); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
}
return names, rows.Err()
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [sql-rows-unclosed]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    sql-rows-unclosed: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore sql-rows-unclosed -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** sql-rows-unclosed
```
